witness.branch: Actual passenger loading during effective hours
witness.quote: except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers
witness.reason: The loading task and loading-zone marking can realize passenger loading in an active passenger curb zone on the fixed one-way road.
required_context: Driver halts a qualifying motor vehicle within the zone and actually loads or unloads passengers.
Establish marked extent, applicable regulations, their source, effective hours and civil time.
Establish passenger designation, marked extent and adjacency to a highway curb or edge, preserving the distinction from freight loading.
Establish qualifying vehicle, driver responsibility, in-zone halt and purpose and complete chronology of actual passenger loading or unloading, with merchandise activity distinguished.
Preserve the scene prerequisite to distinguish passenger and freight purposes and exceptions.
Record activity chronology without interpreting expeditiousness.

Record occupancy, doors and passenger movement as supporting observations, plus conflicts and official directions. Preserve expeditiousness without a cutoff and retain both unresolved sign-hours and municipal-supersession statements.
Resolve the generic marking specifically as a passenger curb loading zone adjacent to the highway curb or edge.
Supply applicable regulations, their source, effective hours and civil date, time and time zone.
witness.subject_reason: The driver is the person causing the covered halt and passenger-loading activity.
